title: Unticking every technician hides the technician chart
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  1. You are signed in as an Admin (the Admin role has every permission, including Reports).
  2. You are in one location (workplace) with the data below.
  3. You use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
  4. At least two technicians appear in the Technician filter of the Technician Efficiency chart (they have clocked time on invoiced lines this month).

Setup

  • For 1: on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Admin (this signs you in as Admin ShopView). To use another role, check it has Reports: profile icon > Settings > Roles & Permissions > edit icon on the role > Reports is switched on.
  • For 2: to change location, click your profile icon (your initials, top right, beside the current location name) > under Change Location: click the orange button showing the current location > pick the location from the list. On the QA site use Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 unless a later line says otherwise.
  • For 4: check: Technician Efficiency (This Month) > View details > Technician filter lists at least two names. If not, create the data as follows: with Tech ShopView: Customers > New Customer > Name > Save (for example ZZAUTOTEST Dash Customer); Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and an Asset (Add beside either if needed) > Save (if a Confirmation says the customer is over their credit limit, click Create); the New Line window opens: What Are You Doing? (any text), Add Technician = Tech ShopView, Labor Rate = EVR Travel to EVO ($100 an hour), Estimated Time 1 and Tech Time 1, tick Line Approved > Save & Close; then the Service Advisor is filled in with your name (Admin ShopView); to use another advisor change Service Advisor in the work order's left panel; clock time as the technician: in a second browser or a private window, on the QA site's sign-in page, in the DEV MODE — QUICK LOGIN panel, click Tech (this signs you in as Tech ShopView, a technician at Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 with Time Clock on); open the work order > on the line's Labor row click Start; when done click Stop > Clock Out; to make the time exact, as Admin: the three dots at the top right of the Lines tab > Timesheets (n) > edit the record's start and end (if it cannot be edited there or in Reports > Timesheet Activities, keep the real time and use the hours Timesheet Activities shows); on the line click Story (Add tech story for this line) > type a short story > Update; click Complete (if a Missing Details window asks for Mileage, enter one > Complete All Lines); click Mark Reviewed; Finance tab > Create Invoice; close the New Customer Payment window without paying (do not send or pay the invoice). Then create a second technician you can sign in as: profile icon > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: a name (for example ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two), an Email you can open, Role Technician, a Department, Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close; accept the invitation email and set a password, and repeat with a second customer and that technician.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. On the Technician Efficiency tile, click View details.
  3. Click the Technician filter button.
  4. Untick every technician.
  5. Close the list and look at where the chart was.
  6. Tick one technician again (any one in the list).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • With no technician ticked the chart is hidden: no empty chart box or empty axes are shown in its place.
  • No message, toast or alert appears.
  • As soon as one technician is ticked again the chart comes back with that technician's line.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9580 (Story 8, Chart Filters); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 8. User Feedback Summary (section 7). Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) board 06_TechEff_After, used for on-screen labels only.
